The '''Detention Guard repulsorcraft''' was used by [[stormtrooper]]s serving on the [[Deck 5|Detention Level]] on-board the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. It was armed with multiple energy weapons and could be operated in two modes, with either the hull opened with the driver exposed or closed to protect them.<ref name="SSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Players had to defeat this craft at the end of a level of the ''[[Super Star Wars]]'' video game, which referred to it as "Detention Guard Boss."<ref name="SSW" />
